newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bank BPA sells Brazil unit to Wachovia.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bank BPA sells Brazil unit to Wachovia.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Portugues do Atlantico (BPA), a unit of Banco Comercial Portugues, said on Tuesday it had sold its unit in Brazil, BPA-Brasil, to a joint venture controlled by U.S. bank Wachovia.

The joint venture, WSH Holdings Ltd, was formed by Wachovia International Capital Corp., the international arm of Wachovia Corp., and by Saenz Hofman International Ltd, a finance company based in Brazil.
BPA said in a statement that it expected the deal to be concluded in the first half of 1997, subject to the agreement of monetary authorities.
BPA did not give the value of the deal.
BCP shares traded up six escudos to 2,045 in volume of 132,109 shares in afternoon trade on Lisbon bourse.
